heading: Adani Total Gas: Why investor preference for the stock is intriguing
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: ATGL's market capitalization of about  ₹70,000 crore remains significantly higher than comparable city gas distribution (CGD) peers such as Indraprastha Gas Ltd (IGL) and Mahanagar Gas Ltd (MGL) that have a market value of of almost  ₹20,800 crore and  ₹10600 crore, respectively.
